rust_summary: the items that make a recipe page's recipes, as a column beside them (`native_panel_catalysts`), heard back as `NativePanelEvent::Catalyst`.
doc_summary:
`native_panel_catalysts(mod_id, catalysts)` (client) shows the items that make the recipes mod `mod_id`'s panel shows now (`native_panel_recipes`) as a column of slots left of them, as JEI draws a category's catalysts: a click on one comes back as `NativePanelEvent::Catalyst { index, stack, right }`, a key over one as `Key`. At most 16; a new recipe page has none until the mod sets them again. On the same page, slots a recipe sends beyond its layout's (`NativeRecipeView::slots`) are drawn as more outputs in a row after the result, and a `note` of several lines (`
`) takes a row each. Bundles need "hooks": @API:panel_catalysts@.
